text: どんどん　つよく　なる…　そう　そんな　わざ　つるぎのまい…　おぼえて　みるか？

structure.jp: どんどん　つよく　なる…
そう　そんな　わざ

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means doing it to see how it goes. おぼえて　みるか = 'will you try learning it?'

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus なる, means 'become that'. つよく　なる = 'become strong'.
